content: If MetaData is configured for a transmitted I - PDU, the I - PDU shall be transmitted with the MetaData last provided by the RTE, or, if no MetaData has been provided by the RTE, with the configured ComMetaDataDefault. MetaData provided by Com_TriggerIPduSendWithMetaData() shall just be used for the transmission triggered by this call.

If MetaData is configured for a transmitted I - PDU, the I - PDU shall be transmitted with the MetaData last provided by the RTE, or, if no MetaData has been provided by the RTE, with the configured ComMetaDataDefault. MetaData provided by Com_TriggerIPduSendWithMetaData() shall just be used for the transmission triggered by this call.

If MetaData is configured for a transmitted I - PDU, the I - PDU shall be transmitted with the MetaData last provided by the user ( e.g. RTE or SwCluC) , or, if no MetaData has been provided by the user , with the configured default values specified by ComMetaDa taItemDefault containers. MetaData provided by Com_TriggerIPduSendWithMetaData() shall just be used for the transmission triggered by this call.

If MetaData is configured for a transmitted I - PDU, the I - PDU shall be transmitted with the MetaData last provided by the user ( e.g. RTE or SwCluC) , or, if no MetaData has been provided by the user , with the configured default values specified by ComMetaDa taItemDefault containers. MetaData provided by Com_TriggerIPduSendWithMetaData() shall just be used for the transmission triggered by this call.

Transmission Side Meta Data Handling If MetaData is con- figured for a transmitted I-PDU, the I-PDU shall be transmitted with the MetaData last provided by the user (e.g. RTE or SwCluC), or, if no MetaData has been provided by the user, with the configured default values specified by ComMetaDataDefaultItem containers. MetaData provided by Com_TriggerIPDUSendWithMetaData shall just be used for the transmission triggered by this call.
